_说明: PBDWiki 构造系统配置。路径与覆盖表可手动编辑；migrate-menus 会自动填充覆盖表。

fetchTip.zh-cn: 该设置的说明与下载器里的说明完全一致。
fetchTip.en: The description of this setting is exactly the same as the description in the downloader.

zh-cn.按钮-下载区域: 下载器首页的“下载区域”里有一些按钮，主要分为两类。有些按钮一开始不会显示，只在有抓取结果之后才会显示。
zh-cn.按钮-开始抓取: 下载器首页的“开始抓取”区域里会显示一些按钮。有些按钮在大部分页面里都会出现，有些按钮则只在特定页面里出现。
zh-cn.按钮-附加功能: 在少数页面里，下载器首页的“附加功能”区域里有一些按钮，你可以按页面类型查看：

en.Buttons-Download-area: The downloader's home page "Download area" contains several buttons, grouped into two main categories. Some buttons are hidden initially and only appear after crawl results are available.
en.Buttons-Extra-features: On a few pages, the "Additional features" area on the downloader's home page contains some buttons; you can view them by page type:
en.Buttons-Start-crawling: In the downloader's home page, the "Start crawl" area displays several buttons. Some buttons appear on most pages, while others only show up on specific pages.
